characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: A regal and authoritative figure, the King is adorned in lavish robes of rich fabric, perhaps velvet or brocade, with intricate golden embroidery. He has a commanding presence with a well-groomed beard, and wears a crown encrusted with jewels. He is often seen gesturing with authority, and is accompanied by symbols of his power, such as a scepter.

characters.name: De tolv sønner
characters.description: The twelve sons are young noblemen, each equipped with a sturdy, well-groomed horse and a set of shining armor that denotes their rank as princes. Each son has his unique features, such as varying hair colors and styles, but they all carry an air of confidence and determination. Their armor is uniform yet personalized, reflecting their individual characters as they venture into the world.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: A modest and humble young man, Askeladden is dressed in simpler clothes compared to his brothers, with an honest and gentle demeanor. He has messy hair and a thoughtful expression, often appearing introspective and a little forlorn. Askeladden is frequently seen sitting in the grass, a symbol of his introspection.

characters.name: Dukken i Græsset
characters.description: Initially, an enchanting and tiny girl with ethereal beauty, she has delicate features and is adorned in finely detailed miniature attire. Her hair is lustrous and perfectly styled despite her small size. Later, she transforms into a full-grown, stunningly beautiful woman with an elegant presence, complementing Askeladden's modesty. She wears delicate clothes that accentuate her magical and fairy tale origins, whether tiny or full-sized.

characters.name: Havmanden
characters.description: A mysterious and otherworldly figure, the Havmanden has a regal presence with striking, possibly aquatic features. He emerges with grace, holding a magical aura that suggests his power over the water. His attire might incorporate elements like pearls or seaweed, creating an appearance both enchanting and intimidating.
